name: WhatsApp
description: App skill for WhatsApp (com.whatsapp & com.whatsapp.w4b) covering chat list inspection (unread badges, read-only counts), chat navigation, media inspection, group chat workflows, and avoiding contact sheet loops.

workflows.name: search_and_open_chat
workflows.steps: 1. Tap the search field reading 'Ask Meta AI or Search' at the top of the Chats home (older versions show a magnifying-glass search icon in the top bar). 2. Type the contact or group name in the search input. 3. Tap the matching contact/chat from the search results list.

workflows.name: send_message
workflows.steps: 1. Open target chat. 2. Tap the message input box 'Message' at the bottom. 3. Type text. 4. Tap the green circular Send button (paper plane icon).

workflows.name: attach_media
workflows.steps: 1. Open chat. 2. Tap paperclip icon near input box. 3. Select Document/Gallery/Camera. 4. Choose media and tap Send.

workflows.name: browse_chat_media_grid
workflows.steps: 1. Open target chat or group. 2. Check thumbnails for undownloaded images (showing download arrow/icon or file size overlay) and tap them to trigger download first. 3. Tap the group/chat title at the top bar to open Chat/Group Info. 4. Tap 'Media, links, and docs'. 5. In the 'Media' tab, tap any undownloaded thumbnails to download, then tap a photo to view and swipe left/right to browse sequentially.

workflows.name: review_every_photo_in_an_album
workflows.steps: 1. Open the chat and find the album bubble (it reads 'Photo album, N items' or offers 'View all N media'). 2. Tap the FIRST thumbnail in the bubble to open MediaViewActivity on item 1 — do NOT go via MediaAlbumActivity, whose grid exposes only two tiles to the accessibility tree and cannot be scrolled to the rest. 3. Read the title bar: it reads '<sender> Today, H:MM am' and is the current photo's identity. If it is missing, the overlay has auto-hidden — tap the photo once to bring it back. 4. Read the photo, state its content in `observation`, then swipe left ONCE on the full-screen image element to advance. 5. Repeat until a swipe left no longer changes the title/photo: that is the end of the album. 6. Two photos sent in the same minute share a title, so an unchanged title is not proof the swipe failed — the NOTE block's item ledger is authoritative.

workflows.name: view_multiple_images_in_chat
workflows.steps: 1. Open target chat or group. 2. Scan chat history for undownloaded images (marked with a download arrow icon) and tap each download icon to download images first. 3. Tap an image thumbnail directly to open full-screen media viewer (avoid tapping sender avatar or name). 4. In full-screen viewer, swipe left (action='swipe', direction='left') for next photo or right for previous photo. If an image displays a central download button, tap it to load the photo before swiping further. 5. Do NOT press back to the album grid to 'pick the next photo' — the grid cannot reach past the second tile and you will restart the album from the beginning.

workflows.name: count_unread_chats_readonly
workflows.steps: 1. Launch with open_app using the full package name 'com.whatsapp' and confirm the foreground screen is com.whatsapp.home.ui.HomeActivity; if only the Android home screen shows, run open_app again. 2. On the Chats tab, read the green numeric badge on the 'Chats' bottom-navigation tab — it is the aggregate unread total. 3. Scan each visible chat row: rows with unread messages include 'N unread message' in their accessibility text and show a green circular badge at the row's right edge with a green timestamp. 4. Scroll the chat list down to reveal more rows and keep counting rows carrying 'unread message' text. 5. Do NOT tap any chat row — opening a chat clears its badge and spoils a read-only count.

nuances: Search top bar icon must be tapped before typing contact names; typing without opening search will not find chats.
Inside chat history, older messages are above (scroll up) and newer messages are below (scroll down).
CRITICAL: Do NOT tap sender profile avatars or sender names on the left side of message bubbles in group chats. Tapping them opens the Contact Info sheet instead of message content.

CONTACT SHEET LOOP PITFALL: If a Contact Info bottom sheet or Profile Photo Viewer opens accidentally, use system back key ('press_key action="back"') to dismiss it. Tapping the center of the sheet or avatar toggles between full-screen profile photo viewer and contact card in an endless loop.
Tapping an image thumbnail opens full-screen media viewer. Swiping left/right in media viewer navigates through images.

MEDIA VIEWER OVERLAY: in MediaViewActivity the toolbar auto-hides after a few seconds. With it visible the tree has ~21 elements and the photo's identity is the title button reading '<sender> Today, H:MM am'; once it hides, the tree collapses to just the image scroller and there is NO way to tell which photo is shown from the tree. Tap the photo once to toggle the overlay back on.

MEDIA VIEWER INDEX DRIFT: because the overlay comes and goes, the full-screen image is listed as #1, #4 or #11 on different turns. It is always the element rendered as [Scroller] "Image" scrollable-h — swipe that one, whatever its number.

ALBUM GRID DEAD END: MediaAlbumActivity ('N photos') publishes only the first two 'Enlarge photo' tiles to the accessibility tree, and scrolling the grid usually reports no change. It cannot be used to reach photo 3 onwards. Open one photo and swipe through the album instead.
SAME-MINUTE DUPLICATES: consecutive photos are often sent within the same minute and then share the identical 'Today, H:MM am' title. Do not conclude a swipe failed just because the title repeated.
Undownloaded images show a download arrow icon / file size overlay on blurred thumbnails. Tapping the download button explicitly downloads the image.
Tapping Group/Chat Header -> 'Media, links, and docs' opens grid view of all shared photos, avoiding chat history scrolling delays.
Do NOT tap 'Jump to latest message' or 'Scroll to bottom' floating arrow while searching past messages as it resets your search position.
Sending a message requires explicit tap on the green Send button after typing in input field.
WhatsApp Web / Linked Device notifications may appear as popups; press back or tap outside to dismiss.

HOME SEARCH BAR: the Chats home top bar is a search field reading 'Ask Meta AI or Search' (with a 'Swipe down to reveal additional actions' hint element beneath it). Tap that field to search; there may be no separate magnifying-glass icon.

UNREAD BADGES IN CHAT LIST: a chat with unread messages shows a green circle with the count at the row's right edge and a green timestamp, and the row's accessibility text includes 'N unread message' (e.g. '01/08/26 1 unread message Reserve Bank of India ..'). The 'Chats' tab in the bottom navigation (Chats / Updates / Communities / Calls) carries a green badge with the aggregate total.
READ-ONLY RULE: opening a chat marks it read and clears its unread badge. For badge-counting tasks, never tap a chat row — count from the list and the Chats tab badge only.

ASK META AI FLOATER: a transient 'Ask Meta AI' bubble can float over the chat list and move or vanish between turns; it is not a chat row — ignore it. A green '+' FAB (new chat) also sits at the bottom right.
recommendations: To check every photo of an album, open the first one and swipe left through the whole album in one pass, recording each photo's content in `observation` as you go. Leaving the viewer and coming back restarts you at photo 1 or 2.
Always tap download arrow icons on undownloaded media thumbnails in chat history or in 'Media, links, and docs' before attempting sequential full-screen viewing or swiping.
To view all photos or shared media efficiently without missing items or getting stuck in message bubbles, navigate to Chat Header -> 'Media, links, and docs'.
Avoid tapping sender avatars/names in group chats; tap image thumbnails in the center of message bubbles.
If trapped in Contact Info sheet or profile photo viewer overlay, immediately run 'press_key action="back"' to exit the loop.
Use scroll_amount=2 to fast scroll through long chat histories when searching for past text messages.
When inspecting long or truncated text messages, tap 'Read more' to expand and view the full text content.
Clear search input before searching for a new contact.
Verify target chat header text matches intended contact before sending messages.

For read-only unread counts, combine the green badge on the 'Chats' bottom-nav tab with per-row 'N unread message' text; scroll the list to cover all rows and never open a chat, since that clears its badge.

After open_app, confirm com.whatsapp is actually in the foreground before acting: the frame captured mid-launch is com.android.systemui, not the app, and a check made on it fails. Retry or wait rather than concluding the launch went to the wrong app.
